name: Claim Information
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837.5010.X222.A1.xml — new segment for Phase 2 (loop 2300, the claim header itself). CLM03/04 (Claim Filing Indicator Code, Non-Institutional Claim Type Code) and CLM13-19 (7 further Yes/No/Level-of-Service/Provider-Agreement/Claim-Status/Claim-Submission-Reason positions) are usage=N at the real occurrence — dropped (safe: they're plain top-level Elements, which align by their own numeric Pos, not array index — see edi/builder/segment_writer.go's writeSegmentInstance). Both composites (C023 Health Care Service Location, C024 Related Causes) reuse the same sub-element-naming discipline SV1's own composites already establish.

IMPORTANT COMPOSITE GOTCHA (found and fixed during Phase 2): unlike a segment's own top-level Elements, a composite's SubElements align by ARRAY INDEX, not by their own Pos string (edi/builder/segment_writer.go's writeComposite does `parts[i]` where i is the Go slice index; edi/loop_engine.go's parseComposite mirrors this on read) — Pos is purely informational for a composite sub-element. C024 sub03 ('Related Causes Code', a third qualifier slot) is usage=N at the real occurrence, but since subs 4 (Auto Accident State Code) and 5 (Country Code) ARE used and come AFTER it, sub03 could NOT simply be omitted the way a top-level dropped position can — doing so would have silently shifted sub04/05's real wire values one position left/right on every build/parse. Kept as a reserved, never-populated placeholder (_reserved3) purely to preserve index alignment. Dropping only TRAILING sub-positions (as every other composite in this schema does) remains safe.
